ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, UBOs, and authorized signatories against domestic disqualification registers, VFSC adverse findings, OFAC SDN List, UN Consolidated List, UK HMT sanctions, EU integrated sanctions list, and public international PEP lists; enhanced due diligence required for PEPs in accordance with FATF Recommendation 12 and domestic AML/CFT Regulation; negative screening must be evidenced and retained for nine years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission – International Companies Name Search and Reservation Facility (VFSC Corporate Registry)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be submitted in Latin alphabet characters; English, French, and Bislama formulations are accepted. The legal suffix 'International Company' or 'IC' is typically required or permitted for an International Company, and the use of any name likely to mislead as to jurisdiction or regulated status is prohibited.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon written rejection, the applicant (usually the licensed registered agent) may file an appeal with the Registrar of International Companies within 14 days, stating the grounds of objection and requesting reconsideration. The appeal must propose a corrected or distinguishing name where appropriate. The Registrar's decision is administratively final; alternatively the applicant may submit a fresh name reservation application after 10 days.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office arrangements are accepted by VFSC for administrative correspondence and registered address purposes, provided the International Company maintains a licensed registered agent in Vanuatu with a physical office capable of receiving legal process and holding statutory records. For an AI data labeling and BPO entity, VFSC regards such arrangements as low-risk if economic substance documentation is maintained and no taxable physical presence is represented.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low to medium: estimated 10% probability of unannounced registered-agent inspection and 5% probability of beneficiary-site inspection in any given compliance year for a standard low-risk International Company; exposure increases only upon anomalous transactional behavior or nomination as agent-inspection target.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1994 (Act No. 19 of 1994), as consolidated and amended; ss. 4 (incorporation by registration), 7 (memorandum of association), 8 (name), 9 (articles of association), 10 (registered office) and 11 (officers)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Companies Office, Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration of an International Company (Form 1) together with Memorandum and Articles of Association and registered agent consent
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital; no escrow deposit or paid-up capital requirement applies to an International Company under the International Companies Act 1994
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF VU_IC TAKEN BY UNANIMOUS WRITTEN CONSENT: RESOLVED, that the subscribers' share subscription be ratified and the proposed allotment of ordinary shares at par value be approved. RESOLVED, that the registered office be established at the address of the licensed registered agent in Port Vila, Vanuatu, and that the registered agent be retained as statutory agent. RESOLVED, that the founder is hereby appointed sole Director, and the Director is authorized to appoint a Secretary and to execute and file all statutory returns. RESOLVED, that the use of Mass PayPal Payout and Wise for operational receipts be approved and that the Director may open segregated client accounts as required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Office / licensed registered agent portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct name search to confirm no identical or confusingly similar name exists. Submit a reservation request through the licensed registered agent; the name must not include prohibited expressions such as 'bank', 'trust', 'insurance', or 'assurance' unless authorized.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If reservation is refused on similarity grounds, file a formal request for review with VFSC or submit up to three alternative names for re-check

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Applicant directors and VFSC-licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association in English, including object clause for computer vision bounding-box annotation and RLHF data curation. Execute the charter documents and obtain consent of the registered agent to act as statutory officer.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any drafting defect identified by VFSC must be cured by amending the instrument and re-filing the corrected version within five business days of query

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of incorporation application to VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Office (in-person at Port Vila, East Wing, or via licensed registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge Form 1 together with executed Memorandum and Articles, declarations of compliance, and proof of identity of the initial shareholder and director. Pay the prescribed filing fee and obtain a filing receipt.
required_dossiers: Form 1 (Application for Registration of an International Company)
Certified passport copy of subscriber and first director
Proof of residential address of subscriber/director
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried for missing or defective documents, submit the requested correction within 30 calendar days; otherwise re-initiate the application with a new Form 1

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of fee and issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Confirm payment of the US$ 350 state filing fee; upon verification, VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation and stamps the constitutive documents as legally effective.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If certificate is delayed, follow up with VFSC Companies Office; if lost, request certified duplicate upon affidavit and payment of duplicate certificate fee

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First board meeting and officer appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold first board meeting by written resolution in lieu of meeting. Ratify subscription, fix registered office at the registered agent's Port Vila address, appoint the sole Director and Secretary, approve banking and payment rail usage (Mass PayPal Payout and Wise), and resolve to open an operational bank account.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If resolution is challenged for lack of quorum, all shareholders may sign a confirmatory written resolution retroactive to the date of the first meeting

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC, Vanuatu Inland Revenue Department (if applicable), and financial institutions
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the first annual return notice with VFSC before the anniversary date; apply for tax identification number only if a physical operation or employment creates a local tax nexus; open a business bank account with a licensed Vanuatu or offshore bank using the certificate of incorporation.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If bank account opening is deferred, request alternative licensed bank acceptance with the same corporate package; tax registration issues are cured by written explanation to the Vanuatu Inland Revenue Department

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable – no industrial permit is triggered for an office-based AI data labeling and BPO company under ISIC 8220 in Vanuatu; regulatory contact is the Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Investment only if a physical service facility is substantially expanded
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable – no operating license or manufacturing permit required for computer vision annotation and RLHF data curation activities

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation, Ministry of Climate Change, Meteorology & Geo-Hazards, Environment, Energy and Disaster Management (Vanuatu)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 3 – Exempt from full EIA; low-impact office activity with no industrial discharge, no combustion emission, and no hazardous waste generation
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater and no VOC emissions; sanitary wastewater discharged via Port Vila municipal sewer in compliance with Vanuatu Environment Act Permit guidelines; e-waste from redundant computing hardware must be collected by an approved waste handling contractor under Vanuatu Waste Management Regulations

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services for the office premises; structural load inspection certificate confirming the safe occupancy of the office floor for required workstation loading; workplace health clearance under the Health and Safety at Work Act showing adequate lighting, ventilation, electrical safety, and ergonomic seating for data-labeling operators

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management - statutory administrator of VAT, excise, and customs (portal: https://customs.gov.vu); Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) - sole registry for International Companies, licensed agents, and tax-exemption certification (portal: https://vfsc.vu).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Vanuatu International Company obtains legal existence through VFSC incorporation, not through an income-tax registration, because Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, and no withholding tax. Steps: (1) engage a VFSC-licensed registered agent in Port Vila; (2) reserve the company name and file the Memorandum and Articles of Association with VFSC under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]; (3) obtain the Certificate of Incorporation and, optionally, a VFSC tax-exemption confirmation; (4) if any domestic Vanuatu taxable supplies are made (e.g., local office lease or local subcontracting), register with VRC for VAT once taxable turnover in a rolling 12-month period reaches or exceeds VT 4,000,000; a purely offshore AI data-labeling and RLHF data-curation BPO serving non-resident clients remains outside the Vanuatu VAT base. The VFSC company registration number serves as the principal statutory identifier; no separate TIN is issued for income-tax purposes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone - the International Company is statutorily exempt from all Vanuatu taxes and duties on profits, income, capital, and transactions arising outside Vanuatu under s. 5 of the International Companies Act [Cap 222]; the exemption also covers shares, debentures, and transfers and is incompatible with conducting business with Vanuatu residents or deriving Vanuatu-source revenue.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or OECD hybrid-mismatch election exists because Vanuatu has no corporate income tax base. Available statutory elections: (1) VFSC tax-exemption certification evidencing freedom from stamp duty and revenue imposts; (2) shareholder election by 75% resolution to re-domicile a foreign company into Vanuatu as an International Company with continuity of exempt status; (3) election to convert the International Company into a Vanuatu domestic company, which revokes exempt status and subjects Vanuatu-source activity to VAT, the 0.5% Consumer Compensation Levy, and municipal business-license fees; and (4) election to enhance limited-liability and share-structure provisions subject to VFSC beneficial-ownership registration. Any election touching resident-source activity triggers VRC and VFSC review.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act No. 6 of 1998, effective 1 July 1998, with the standard rate raised from 12.5% to 15% effective 1 January 2017; administered alongside the Consumer Compensation Levy Act No. 4 of 1995 (0.5% levy on imports and domestic supplies for local consumption).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 4,000,000 in taxable supplies per rolling 12-month period (approximately USD 33,000-35,000); registration is compulsory once the threshold is met, with voluntary registration permitted below the threshold. A purely offshore export-oriented International Company is not 'making supplies in Vanuatu' and therefore does not cross the threshold and holds no VRC VAT registration.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Vanuatu operates no real-time fiscal clearance system, no digital stamping, no SAF-T schema, and no government API pre-clearance gateway. A VAT-registered supplier must issue a prescribed tax invoice under the VAT Act containing supplier and buyer identification, description and quantity of the supply, tax-exclusive price, VAT at 15%, invoice date, and serial number, and must retain records for seven years. Electronic invoices are accepted on VRC audit but are not subject to any live clearance or approval mechanism.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export of goods and services supplied to recipients belonging outside Vanuatu qualify for the 0% rate under the export provisions of the Value Added Tax Act 1998. For a computer-vision bounding-box annotation and RLHF data-curation BPO, the applicable tests are: (i) the recipient of the training-data and annotation services belongs outside Vanuatu; (ii) the contract, annotation delivery logs, and invoices squarely evidence offshore destination and foreign consumption; (iii) no material benefit of the service is consumed inside Vanuatu; and (iv) export proceeds are traceable to the foreign principal. A pure-export International Company sits entirely outside the VAT base and therefore does not charge output VAT, file VAT returns, or claim input-VAT refunds; the zero-rating mechanism is practically relevant only for a mixed-activity entity that holds a domestic VAT registration and exports services while seeking input-VAT recovery.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Asycuda World filing) with applicable tariff or H.S. classification
Bill of Lading / Airway Bill or equivalent digital delivery evidence for the goods element
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT MT103 evidencing foreign-currency settlement of export proceeds
Signed service contract and commercial invoice identifying the non-resident recipient of the AI data-labeling / RLHF service
Zero-rated VAT tax invoice compliant with s. 18 of the VAT Act and proof of service delivery (annotation batch reports, model-training data logs, client acceptance certificates)
Bank-account statement traces reconciling receipt currency, counterparty, and the 180-day repatriation window
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VRC may audit zero-rated export claims against the foreign-recipient contract, delivery evidence, and inward-remittance trace. Failure to substantiate the export within the 180-day repatriation convention triggers: assessment of output VAT at 15% on the gross consideration; a late-payment penalty of 10% of the assessed tax; monthly interest at approximately 2% per month; and civil penalties under the VAT Act, with wilful evasion or knowingly false documentation constituting a criminal offence carrying fines of up to VT 1,000,000 and/or imprisonment for up to two years, together with retrospective clawback of input-VAT credits and denial of zero-rating for the entire engagement. For the International Company vehicle, VFSC may strike off the company or revoke the tax-exemption certificate for breaches of the non-residence conditions, such as contracting with a Vanuatu-resident party or maintaining a domestic physical presence, with retrospective assessment of all taxes that would otherwise have applied, plus business-license arrears, VAT, and penalties.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) - the central monetary authority and supervisory body for banks, foreign-exchange dealers, and payment service providers, exercising exchange-control and AML/CFT oversight under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act, the Financial Transactions Reporting Act, and applicable exchange-control regulations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu operates a liberalized exchange-control regime. Both current account and capital account transactions are generally freely permitted, and the Vatu (VUV) is convertible through licensed commercial banks for legitimate trade and investment purposes. No statutory pre-approval is required for routine capital injections, loan repayments, or profit repatriation by International Companies. Profit remittance relies primarily on standard know-your-customer and source-of-funds verification by the banking system, with no material conversion restrictions; practical market depth for VUV is limited, so USD and AUD are the dominant settlement currencies.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu imposes no mandatory surrender of export proceeds into Vatu and no fixed statutory conversion ratio. Cross-border receipts may be retained in foreign currency in an offshore-compliant account or converted as needed. The only compliance requirements relate to accurate transaction documentation, beneficial-ownership declarations, and record retention for anti-money laundering oversight under the Financial Transactions Reporting Act.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low to Medium. Under Vanuatu's Financial Dealers Licensing Act and the Banking Act, holding client funds, operating a payment account, or providing money-transfer services from within Vanuatu requires licensing by the RBV. Unlicensed offshore digital EMIs are not viable as primary treasury accounts; however, established global EMIs such as Wise and PayPal Payouts may be used peripherally as disbursement rails if the Vanuatu International Company maintains a funded commercial bank account at a tier-1 VU bank and the EMI satisfies its own internal international-corporate onboarding checks. The legal constraint is that the EMI must not purport to be a licensed Vanuatu bank or money remitter.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical or live-interview presence is effectively mandatory. Tier-1 Vanuatu banks generally require at least one director, an authorized signatory, and any 25% or greater ultimate beneficial owner to attend an in-person KYC interview at the bank's office in Port Vila or, where permitted, a supervised video interview approved by the bank's compliance officer. Remote opening for non-resident International Companies is possible only through a licensed introducer or registered agent with a pre-existing bank relationship, but full documentary due diligence and beneficial-ownership disclosure are still compulsory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore International Company with no physical presence, no audited financials, and outsourced management services flagged as a possible shell-entity structure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Incorporation; Memorandum and Articles of Association; Register of Directors and Members; Certificate of Good Standing from the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission; notarized registered-agent service agreement; UBO declaration; economic-substance narrative; corporate bank reference from the foreign parent; invoice and payroll contracts demonstrating active AI data-labeling BPO operations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume mass payouts to multiple foreign contractors and individual data-labeling workers may trigger red flags for unauthorized money-services business or layering.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed master service agreements with each data-labeling supplier; centralized disbursement ledger; contractor KYC/ID verification files; payroll schedule and invoice backups; outsourced AML-compliance policy; transaction monitoring procedure; written confirmation that no third-party client funds are received or held on behalf of other parties.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Reliance on PayPal Payouts, Wise, and similar aggregators creates opacity in the end-to-end settlement chain and raises counterparty-verification concerns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: EMI/platform account certification; verified business-account ownership certificate; platform settlement statements; treasury policy detailing the commercial purpose of aggregator rails; source-of-funds bank statement from the tier-1 Vanuatu account; reconciliation report showing every payout is tied to an invoiced service milestone.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Potential undisclosed nominee shareholders or bearer-style instruments shielding the true controller of the International Company.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Official register of shareholders in original form; declarations of trust and nominee agreements if a professional nominee is used; consent-and-declaration forms from all directors; VFSC UBO filing confirmation; statutory declarations explaining the source of capital; no-bearer-shares confirmation from the registered agent.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity and shareholder-loan funding is executed via SWIFT MT103 wires from the foreign parent or shareholder operating account to the Vanuatu International Company's tier-1 bank account. The payment narrative in field 70 must contain 'INBOUND CAPITAL INJECTION - SHAREHOLDER LOAN - [ENTITY NAME]' plus the underlying loan-agreement reference. Foreign banks should use a trade/investment purpose code reflecting issuance/transfer of equity security or intercompany financing. The VU beneficiary bank will require the register of directors, membership resolution approving the capital contribution, and source-of-funds evidence for the remitting entity. No exchange-control filing is required, but the bank must maintain a complete transaction record for the statutory AML record-retention period.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Operational disbursements should use SWIFT MT103 wires for vendor invoices and outsourced BPO services; for large physical or high-value transactions, confirmed sight commercial letters of credit may be advised through ANZ or BRED Bank Vanuatu. Recurring global mass payouts to data-labeling contractors are cleared through the commercial bank account via mass-payout APIs to Wise or PayPal Payouts, with each disbursement referencing the settlement-period invoice. The preferred clearing architecture is: tier-1 VU operating account as the sole liquidity hub; monthly funding of EMI/Wise/PayPal business wallets; automated file reconciliation against contractor invoices and the BPO fee schedule; and full SWIFT audit-trail capture for all bank-to-bank settlement.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore USD/VUV forward foreign-exchange contract with a licensed Vanuatu commercial bank
USD/VUV foreign-exchange swap executed under an ISDA or bank master agreement
Cross-currency swap for long-term balance-sheet hedging where the underlying exposure is documented
Vanilla foreign-exchange option (call/put) on a case-by-case bank-approved basis
Offshore non-deliverable forward (NDF) referencing VUV where onshore deliverable liquidity is impractical

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Licence Renewal and Registered Agent Declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) through the registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On the anniversary of incorporation, or as stipulated by VFSC in the annual renewal circular; the registered agent submits and pays before the strike-off effective date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment attracts late-penalty interest and may lead to escalation of VFSC compliance fees; continued non-payment on the anniversary failure triggers administrative strike-off with publication in the Official Gazette and loss of limited liability status

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership Register Confirmation and Share Transfer Update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered agent on behalf of the International Company; available for VFSC AML/CFT inspection
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: At least annually on the company anniversary and within 14 days following any transfer of shares or change in beneficial ownership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain and confirm accurate UBO records exposes the company and registered agent to monetary penalties under the Vanuatu AML/CFT regime, and repeat non-compliance may be reported to VFSC for administrative action

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A Vanuatu International Company is not required to undergo a statutory audit unless the company's constitution or shareholders impose an audit, or the company holds a regulatory licence under VFSC that mandates audited financial statements. ISIC 8220 data-labeling BPO operations are not subject to a compulsory audit threshold by law.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No prescribed statutory accounting framework for exempted Vanuatu International Companies. Where financial statements are voluntarily prepared, IFRS or acceptable local accounting practice may be adopted; underlying records must be sufficient to explain transactions and enable a true and fair view.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The International Company must file initial beneficial ownership information with its registered agent and keep that register current. At least once per year, the registered agent must reconfirm the UBO record; in the event of a share transfer, the company must update the register of members and beneficial owner register promptly, and disclose the transfer on the next annual confirmation. VFSC may request inspection of the UBO record without further filing requirement.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 650–1,200 per year for registered agent, office, and secretarial services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 0 for exempted International Company; USD 2,500–5,000 for voluntary certified audit or if imposed by shareholder resolution

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Vanuatu operates a zero-rate income tax system: no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, no branch remittance tax, and no payroll income tax is levied on International Companies (ICs). The effective tax rate on AI data-labeling and RLHF service fees derived by the IC is therefore permanently 0%. The only statutory imposts are the annual VFSC government fee (VUV 40,000 for an IC), stamp duty on certain asset transfers, and 15% VAT on qualifying domestic supplies; data-labeling services supplied to foreign clients are exported services and fall outside Vanuatu VAT.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return form exists in Vanuatu. Annual compliance filing consists of (1) the VFSC Annual Return prescribed under the International Companies Act 2012, filed through the licensed registered agent via the VFSC e-Registry, and (2) where applicable, the annual Economic Substance Return (ESR-IC Annual Return) filed through the VFSC ESR e-portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: VFSC Annual Return: due within 30 days after the anniversary of incorporation each year. ESR-IC Return: due within 12 months after the end of the financial reporting period, normally aligned to 31 December unless otherwise directed by the VFSC notice.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The exact registered legal name of the International Company.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the name exactly as it appears on the Certificate of Incorporation; no separate tax reference is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The unique VFSC registration number assigned to the IC.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The VFSC number functions as the company's sole identification marker; Vanuatu issues no separate tax identification number.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and license number of the VFSC-licensed registered agent maintaining the statutory registered office in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident beneficial owner must appoint and retain a licensed registered agent as the mandatory channel for all VFSC correspondence; the agent's identity and address are conclusive.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Current list of directors and members with appointment and cessation dates.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors and members may all be non-resident; no public register of shareholders exists, and the information is held confidentially by the registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The statutory office address in Vanuatu at which legal process may be served.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The address is the registered agent's office; the IC's actual AI-training operations may be performed entirely outside Vanuatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: ESR-IC Box A - Relevant Activity Declaration
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of whether the IC carried on a relevant activity under the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2019 during the reporting period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For an offshore data-labeling BPO the customary answer is 'No relevant activity' where services are rendered exclusively to unrelated clients and all activity occurs abroad, or 'Distribution and service centre' where annotation/RLHF services are supplied to related group entities.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: ESR-IC Box B - Tax Residence Declaration
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement of the jurisdiction of tax residence relied upon to claim exemption from full Vanuatu economic substance requirements.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the IC declares foreign tax residence (for example Australia or Hong Kong), the foreign tax file number and supporting certificate must be uploaded; a wholly passive IC with no foreign tax file may instead claim Vanuatu tax residence status, which triggers full ESR compliance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: ESR-IC Box C - Core Income-Generating Activities Location
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Location and description of core income-generating activities performed during the reporting period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Describe the client-side AI data-labeling operation (annotation workforce, RLHF training loop, quality assurance) and state that all core income-generating activities are performed abroad; the Vanuatu IC acts only as contractual counterparty and treasury vehicle.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of employees, floor area of local premises, and local operating expenditure attributable to the Vanuatu entity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Zero employees and zero local premises are acceptable only under the foreign-tax-residence exemption; otherwise the IC must demonstrate premises, local personnel, and expenditure proportionate to revenue.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late VFSC Annual Return: late filing fee of VUV 5,000 per month (current VFSC practice) up to 12 months, followed by administrative strike-off and deregistration; statutory maximum fine for non-compliance is VUV 500,000. ESR-IC late or defective filing: initial penalty of VUV 300,000 escalating to VUV 500,000, deregistration of the IC, and exchange-of-information notifications to foreign revenue authorities.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Because Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax and no dividend withholding tax, a dividend paid by the Vanuatu IC to its foreign parent or individual owner is distributed free of any Vanuatu statutory withholding; no DTA relief claim or fiscal reclaim procedure exists in Vanuatu. Where the shareholder's home jurisdiction requires proof of the IC's zero-tax status, the registered agent obtains from the VFSC a Certificate of Good Standing together with an incumbency letter stating the IC's exemption from Vanuatu taxation; that document serves as the functional equivalent of a tax residence certificate. Vanuatu's limited DTA network, notably the France-Vanuatu Convention and the signed but not yet in force Australia-Vanuatu DTA, is not engaged because no Vanuatu domestic tax is chargeable on the distribution.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates: 0% for royalties and 0% for interest paid by a Vanuatu IC to any foreign recipient. Treaty rates are irrelevant in practice because no Vanuatu tax arises on VU-source outbound payments. The data-labeling BPO contract should nevertheless include gross-up provisions addressing Mass_PayPal_Payout and Wise payout fees, and any client-side withholding imposed under the client's local payment regulations.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: VUV 0 (not applicable). Vanuatu has no corporate income tax and has enacted no transfer pricing documentation threshold; no Local File or Master File regime exists. The operative threshold is instead the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2019, which requires an IC carrying on a relevant activity to maintain contemporaneous records demonstrating adequate economic substance and arm's-length allocation of income.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2019 and its subsidiary regulations transpose internationally agreed substance requirements onto International Companies. Covered relevant activities include banking, insurance, shipping, fund management, financing and leasing, headquarters, holding company, intellectual property, and distribution and service centres. An AI data-labeling and RLHF BPO IC rendering services exclusively to unrelated clients and performing all processing abroad falls outside the relevant-activity net; however, if the same IC invoices related group companies, the distribution and service centre head may apply, requiring a physical office, qualified local personnel, and local operating expenditure proportionate to revenue. A fully remote BPO that cannot satisfy those physical-presence tests should either declare tax residence in the shareholder's jurisdiction, thereby invoking the foreign-tax-resident exclusion, or avoid interposition in related-party payment chains.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and Conspiracy to Defraud Foreign Revenue
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the zero-tax Vanuatu IC as an invoice-mill that books AI-training service income while economic activity, control, and personnel remain entirely in a high-tax jurisdiction, with the deliberate intent of eroding that jurisdiction's tax base.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu domestic law imposes no CIT sanction, but the VFSC invokes good-standing and anti-avoidance powers: administrative penalty up to VUV 500,000, compulsory deregistration, and formal notification to the foreign tax authority through Vanuatu's exchange-of-information framework, as Vanuatu participates in CRS and maintains TIEA arrangements with Australia, New Zealand, France, and EU member states.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly sign false VFSC declarations face criminal fines and up to 12 months' imprisonment under the International Companies Act; where concealment of foreign tax liabilities is proven overseas, the foreign parent entity is exposed to its domestic penalties and directors may be subjected to restraining orders and travel restrictions pending asset recovery proceedings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Economic Substance Evasion
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the IC as an empty shell: no ESR return filed, no maintained local agency, related-party data-labeling invoices flowing through a substance-less entity, and refusal to disclose beneficial ownership to the registered agent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Breach of the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2019 attracts an initial VUV 300,000 penalty, escalating to VUV 500,000 for continuing non-compliance, followed by mandatory strike-off of the company and a bar on re-registration under the same name; the registered agent itself faces license suspension for enabling the evasion.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil is pierced: a director who fails to ensure ESR filings becomes jointly and severally liable for the company's unpaid penalties; the VFSC may disqualify the director from managing any Vanuatu company for up to 5 years, with compliance compelled through civil contempt proceedings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving Mass_PayPal_Payout or Wise payments for annotation and RLHF services without customer due diligence, acting with knowledge or wilful blindness that funds derive from prohibited gambling, fraud proceeds, or sanctions circumvention, or structuring payouts to evade foreign anti-money-laundering reporting thresholds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu's Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2017 criminalizes laundering of proceeds of crime with imprisonment of up to 20 years and/or a fine of up to VUV 500,000; ancillary contraventions, including a false beneficial ownership declaration, attract summary corporate penalties of up to VUV 1,000,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and beneficial owners are prosecuted as principals where the IC lacked an AML compliance framework or where a director personally authorized the tainted payout route; sanctions extend to seizure and forfeiture of the IC's bank balances, including frozen PayPal and Wise receivables, freezing orders over foreign-held assets, and judicial travel bans enforced by the Vanuatu Police pending extradition or international arrest operations.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: False Annual Return Declarations to the Registrar
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Submitting knowingly false shareholder and director particulars, fabricating the ESR tax residence declaration, or backdating director resignations to conceal continuity of control over the AI-training BPO cash flows.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Making a false statement under the International Companies Act 2012 is a criminal offence carrying a fine of up to VUV 500,000 and, upon indictment, imprisonment for up to 12 months; the company is struck off and verified beneficial ownership information is forwarded to foreign authorities under Vanuatu's information exchange commitments.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A nominee director is personally exposed even where instructions originated from offshore executives; the law treats the registered director as the statutory author of the declaration. Personal liability includes civil restitution to the company's creditors, directorial disqualification, enforcement of judgments against personal assets in Vanuatu, and custodial sentences; no corporate indemnity overrides the director's statutory non-delegable duties.
